Thane, Maharashtra, India • +91-8419976595 • devakshelar1997@gmail.com• linkedin.com/in/devak-shelar 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
Finance Analyst with 4+ years of experience across financial reconciliation, hedge fund operations, portfolio 
services, cash management, trade settlement and regulatory reporting. Hands-on experience supporting MiFID 
II regulatory compliance and NDF transaction reporting, with strong expertise in reconciliation, exception 
investigation, cash and liquidity management, trade settlement and operational oversight. Experienced in 
working with investment, trading, custodial and service-provider teams to resolve breaks, maintain operational 
controls and deliver time-sensitive regulatory and client requirements. 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
 
Finance Analyst | Morgan Stanley Aug 2024 – Present 
 
• Manage regulatory and product-specific reporting activities, including MiFID II regulatory reporting and Non-
Deliverable Forward (NDF) transaction reporting, ensuring data accuracy, completeness and adherence to 
applicable reporting requirements.  
• Perform data validation, reconciliation and exception analysis across regulatory and operational reporting 
flows; investigate discrepancies, identify root causes and coordinate timely resolution with relevant 
stakeholders.  
• Conduct oversight reconciliations across multiple investment strategies, investigating trade breaks, failed 
trades, overdraft exceptions and settlement-related discrepancies.  
• Monitor internal and external operational deliverables, including service-provider performance, accuracy, 
timeliness and SLA adherence; escalate material exceptions to Global Oversight and functional teams.  
• Handle client and operational queries, coordinating with Investment, Trading, Treasury, Operations, 
custodians, counterparties and service providers to resolve issues within defined SLAs.  
• Support client training and process walkthrough sessions, explaining operational workflows, reporting 
processes and issue-resolution procedures to client stakeholders.  
• Support UAT and system enhancements by preparing test scenarios, validating expected versus actual results, 
investigating defects and coordinating fixes with technology teams.  
• Manage cash projections, liquidity requirements and settlement funding across multiple investment strategies, 
coordinating with State Street IMS, Trading teams, counterparties and custodians.  
• Support Money Market Fund subscription and redemption settlement instructions, ensuring accurate and 
timely processing of fund transactions.  
• Manage MiFID II research operations, including research package administration, disclosure management, 
data reconciliation and query resolution.  
• Prepare and maintain operational reports, exception trackers and management information to support 
oversight, regulatory requirements and decision-making.  
• Utilized Excel VBA-based automation to streamline repetitive reconciliation and reporting activities, reducing 
manual intervention and improving operational efficiency.  
• Contribute to process and workflow improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to reduce operational 
exceptions and improve reporting and processing efficiency. 
 
Financial Analyst | SS&C GlobeOp Financial Services Aug 2021 – Aug 2023 
 
• Performed daily hedge fund reconciliations between Geneva accounting records and Prime Broker/Custodian 
statements across cash, derivatives, equities, and mutual funds, identifying and resolving reconciliation breaks 
and exceptions. 
• Configured the SS&C platform based on client-specific requirements and processed trade uploads through 
manual and automated workflows, ensuring accurate and timely trade processing. 
• Processed and booked corporate actions, including rights issues, bonuses, stock splits, and dividends; 
supported NAV calculation and investigated and resolved breaks with brokers and fund managers. 
• Prepared monthly, quarterly, and year-end fund reports, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery; responded to ad-
hoc investor queries and supported fund reporting requirements. 
• Coordinated with UK and US clients, brokers, fund managers, Finance, and Asset Management teams to resolve 
operational issues, manage exceptions, and ensure timely and accurate fund operations. 
 
Finance Advisor Intern | Asset Villa      Summer Internship, 2 months 
• Conducted equity research, fundamental analysis, and data gathering for the Indian oil and gas sector. 
• Built foundational knowledge of stock market operations and derivatives products through applied research and 
analysis.
